item.title: Matte Black Bottle on Marble

turns.text: Make a product photo of a matte black water bottle on marble, with soft light.

item.tests: Produces a finished product image from text while honoring the stated material, setting and lighting.
must_haves: A water bottle is the main subject and is fully visible.
The bottle has a matte black finish rather than a glossy or metallic finish.
The bottle stands on a visibly veined marble surface.
Lighting is soft, with gentle shadows rather than harsh glare.

turns.text: Could you make a product photo for me, because that's the kind of image I'm looking for here? I've been thinking about this for a while and wanted to finally ask for help with it. The product itself is a water bottle, and the finish I mean is matte black. For where it sits, I'd like it on marble, with soft light in the photo. I'm a little worried I'm over-explaining something quite simple.
turns.agent:
Your brief is clear—no over-explaining at all. I couldn’t generate the photo because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

Here’s the prompt ready to use when credits are available:

> A clean, photorealistic product photograph of a matte-black water bottle standing on white marble with subtle gray veining. Soft, diffused side lighting, gentle shadows, and restrained highlights that preserve the matte finish. Minimal light-gray background, no logo or text, with the entire bottle visible.

Bottle standing upright on white marble with subtle pale gray veining. Soft diffused window lighting from the left, gentle realistic contact shadow, restrained highlights that clearly preserve the matte powder-coated texture. Clean minimalist composition, entire bottle and cap visible, centered with generous breathing room, neutral light gray background softly out of focus, elegant commercial ecommerce photography, crisp product detail, natural proportions.
